title: The prescribed Koszul functor preserves zero morphisms
statement: Let A be a commutative condensed ring and r a natural number. For any KoszulModel K over A and rank r with the finite ordered-subset coordinates and coordinatewise maps of [lem-sfb-discrete-lattice-koszul-resolution], K.functor preserves zero morphisms: for every pair of equivariant modules P,Q, its image of the zero map P to Q is the zero chain map. The module also retains the existing normalized discrete-comparison, total-complex and tensor-augmentation definitions used to state the parent.

proof.text: Use chain-map extensionality to fix a degree a. Cancel the source inverse coordinate isomorphism and target coordinate isomorphism. Apply finite-biproduct extensionality first to source inclusions I and then to target projections J. By KoszulModel.maps the resulting matrix entry for the zero map is zero, whether I equals J or not. The zero chain map has zero components and composition with zero is zero. This proves equality in every degree, including empty subset-index types outside [0,r].
